signingNeeds.build: none: the package is not signed; it is pinned by its MANIFEST digest (host.json + descriptor)
signingNeeds.perReplica: the REGISTRY OPERATOR of each storage host personal_signs the descriptor bytes (storage-closeout activation/descriptor.mjs request/assemble); rc3 changes the pin, so the descriptor must name the rc3 manifest pin (no rc2 descriptor was ever signed)
signingNeeds.platformPolicy: existing admin-signed anchored policy must admit each host (admin action only if a host is not yet admitted or allowlist mode); admin ban control preserved
signingNeeds.siaS3Publish: catalog publishVersion of the new sia-s3 version by the sia-s3 slug owner; approved on publish only if that owner is the catalog owner (rev 9), else catalog-owner approval (admin)
signingNeeds.siaS3Deploy: deployment owner signatures: version switch/redeploy and every secrets put (message signatures); app-key registration on each new indexer is an indexd admin-API step on that host (admin password credential), not a wallet signature
signingNeeds.front: front/relay with the lease-generation writer-authority binding: new measured Shield/SNP builds through the existing release process (release owner key/signature currently absent per latest-progress)
signingNeeds.contracts: none: no contract, registry field or ownership change
